It truly is frightening how much information is capable of being collected and how easily it would be to abuse the information for personal gain. From blackmailing politicians through their private conversations to acquiring bank account passwords and eradicating an individual's entire life savings with a few clicks of a mouse. It's the ultimate tool to ensure complete control over the masses. Any attempt at dissent is squashed before the individual even has time to realize he's a target. It's entirely preemptive, entirely immoral and unjustifiable, and should be entirely illegal.

It becomes even more terrifying (if that's even possible) when one realizes that the organization collection this data is the same organization that claims that encryption is only for terrorists, leading to situations like the recent OPM hack in which millions of incredibly detailed personnel files were obtained.
